name: leaf_bamboo

Long narrow elegant lance-shaped jade-green leaf with a gentle natural bend, tapered pointed tip, slim central vein, softly rounded tactile leaf surface and warm upper-left rim light. Vertical leaning slightly diagonally, sized to fit final 48x96 transparent RGBA canvas with small clear margin on every side. Clear simple silhouette readable tiny. No second leaf, no attached branch, no ground shadow, no object behind, no text or glow. Genuine transparent background.
